integrity: The primary source was inspected at Definition 3.7, Definition 3.8, Lemma 3.10, Theorems 3.12 and 3.13, Corollary 3.14, and its prospects discussion. The polynomial relevance lemma was reconstructed independently and stress-tested against the infinite conjunction closure generated by axiom C. The closest exact complexity literature was inspected in full text and distinguished because its classical non-normal systems include replacement of equivalents.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the sixteen fixed systems whose parameter set is contained in {M,C,N,K}; no classification is claimed for systems containing modal inference rules E or G. The polynomial algorithm computes only closure membership in the input-relevant finite fragment, not the entire unrestricted closure. A plausible older non-congruential-semantics paper was available only at abstract/metadata level in the lawful noninteractive sources checked, so an unstated overlapping complexity theorem there remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact coNP complexity for closure logics without modal inference rules
